blocks.prompt: 7. For what value of \(n\), \(\frac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^n + b^n}\) is the A.M. between \(a\) and \(b\), where \(a \ne b\).
blocks.explanation:
Humein woh \(n\) chahiye jis par di hui expression A.M. \(\frac{a + b}{2}\) ke barabar ho jaye.
Is liye dono ko barabar rakh kar equation banayenge. Cross-multiply se denominators hat jayenge.
Plan: sab terms ek taraf la kar grouping karenge taake \((a - b)\) common factor nikle; phir \(a \ne b\) ki shart istemal kar ke \(n\) nikalenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^n + b^n}\) A.M. hai \(a\) aur \(b\) ka; \(a \ne b\)
Humein find karna hai: \(n\) ki value.
Tareeqa: Expression ko \(\frac{a + b}{2}\) ke barabar rakhenge, cross-multiply karenge, factorise karenge, aur \(a \ne b\) ki shart se \(n\) nikalenge.

A.M. ke barabar rakh kar cross-multiply karein
\[\dfrac{a^{n+1} + b^{n+1}}{a^n + b^n} = \dfrac{a + b}{2}\]
\[2a^{n+1} + 2b^{n+1}\]
\[= (a + b)(a^n + b^n)\]
Kyun: Cross-multiply se dono denominators hat gaye: 2 left side par aa gaya aur \((a^n + b^n)\) right side par chala gaya. Ab fractions ke baghair kaam karna aasaan hai.

Right side kholein
\[(a + b)(a^n + b^n)\]
\[= a^{n+1} + ab^n + a^nb + b^{n+1}\]
Kyun: Har term ko har term se multiply kiya. Law of indices (powers ka qaida): ek hi base ki powers multiply hon to powers jama hoti hain, \(a \cdot a^n = a^{1 + n}\). Is tarah chaar terms bane.

Sab terms ek taraf laayein
\[a^{n+1} - a^nb - ab^n + b^{n+1} = 0\]
Kyun: Right side ko left se minus kiya: \(2a^{n+1} - a^{n+1} = a^{n+1}\) aur \(2b^{n+1} - b^{n+1} = b^{n+1}\); beech ke do terms minus ke saath aa gaye.

Grouping kar ke factorise karein
\[a^n(a - b) - b^n(a - b) = 0\]
\[(a - b)(a^n - b^n) = 0\]
Kyun: Pehle do terms se \(a^n\) nikala: \(a^n(a - b)\). Aakhri do terms se \(-b^n\) nikala: \(-b^n(a - b)\), kyunke \(-ab^n + b^{n+1} = -b^n(a - b)\). Ab dono mein \((a - b)\) common hai.

\(a \ne b\) se \(n\) nikalein
\[a - b \ne 0 \Rightarrow a^n = b^n\]
\[\left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^n = 1 = \left(\dfrac{a}{b}\right)^0\]
\[n = 0\]
Kyun: \(a \ne b\) hai, is liye \(a - b\) zero nahi aur hum is se divide kar sakte hain; \(a^n - b^n = 0\) bacha. Dono taraf \(b^n\) se divide kiya to \((\frac{a}{b})^n = 1\). Kisi bhi non-zero number ki power 0 par jawab 1 hota hai, is liye \(n = 0\). (Yeh aam positive numbers \(a, b\) ke liye hai; book bhi yahi jawab deti hai.)

Tasdeeq
\[n = 0:\ \dfrac{a^1 + b^1}{a^0 + b^0}\]
\[= \dfrac{a + b}{1 + 1} = \dfrac{a + b}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 0\) rakhne se \(a^0 = b^0 = 1\), to denominator 2 aur numerator \(a + b\) ban jata hai, yani bilkul A.M.
Dhyan dein: \(a^0 = 1\) hota hai, 0 nahi.
